measures.name: order_count_measure
measures.expr: order_id

measures.name: paid_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then order_id end

measures.name: valid_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end

measures.name: cancelled_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'cancelled' then order_id end

measures.name: refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then order_id end

measures.name: partial_refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 and refund_cents < paid_cents then order_id end

measures.name: full_refund_order_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents > 0 and refund_cents = paid_cents then order_id end

measures.name: payment_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end

measures.name: refund_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end

measures.name: net_sales_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end

measures.name: gross_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end

measures.name: discount_cents_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end

measures.name: buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end

measures.name: refund_buyer_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then member_id end

measures.name: selling_store_count_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then store_id end

measures.name: valid_order_items_measure
measures.expr: case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end

measures.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count_measure

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.description: 按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号一次，包含取消单。
metrics.label: 创建订单数

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后来全部退款的订单。
metrics.label: 支付订单数

metrics.name: valid_order_count
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单数；取消和全退不计。
metrics.label: 有效订单数

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。
metrics.label: 取消订单数

metrics.name: refund_order_count
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数，包括部分退款与全部退款。
metrics.label: 退款订单数

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款大于零、小于实付金额的订单数。
metrics.label: 部分退款订单数

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count
metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零、退款等于实付的订单数。
metrics.label: 全额退款订单数

metrics.name: payment_cents
metrics.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，尚未扣退款；单位分。
metrics.label: 实付金额

metrics.name: refund_cents
metrics.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属，不是现金退款发生日；单位分。
metrics.label: 退款金额

metrics.name: net_sales_cents
metrics.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计；取消单不计；按原订单下单日期归属；单位分。
metrics.label: 净销售额

metrics.name: gross_cents
metrics.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计；单位分。
metrics.label: 支付订单原价金额

metrics.name: discount_cents
metrics.description: paid 订单原价减实付的金额合计；退款不冲减原优惠金额；单位分。
metrics.label: 优惠金额

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.description: 统计窗口及筛选条件内有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数，不做跨系统自然人去重。
metrics.label: 购买会员数

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count
metrics.description: 统计窗口内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。
metrics.label: 退款会员数

metrics.name: selling_store_count
metrics.description: 窗口内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。
metrics.label: 成交门店数

metrics.name: valid_order_items
metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计；退款金额不能推算退货件数，此项不是净商品销量。
metrics.label: 有效订单商品件数

metrics.name: avg_order_value
metrics.description: 净销售额除以有效订单数，单位分／单；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when valid_order_count = 0 then null else net_sales_cents / valid_order_count end

metrics.label: 有效订单均额

metrics.name: avg_buyer_value
metrics.description: 净销售额除以购买会员数，单位分／账户；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when buyer_count = 0 then null else net_sales_cents / buyer_count end

metrics.label: 购买会员人均消费

metrics.name: purchase_frequency
metrics.description: 有效订单数除以购买会员数，单位单／账户；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when buyer_count = 0 then null else valid_order_count / buyer_count end

metrics.label: 购买频次

metrics.name: refund_amount_rate
metrics.description: 退款金额除以实付金额；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when payment_cents = 0 then null else refund_cents / payment_cents end

metrics.label: 退款金额占比

metrics.name: cancel_rate
metrics.description: 取消订单数除以创建订单数；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when order_count = 0 then null else cancelled_order_count / order_count end

metrics.label: 取消率

metrics.name: refund_order_rate
metrics.description: 退款订单数除以支付订单数；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when paid_order_count = 0 then null else refund_order_count / paid_order_count end

metrics.label: 退款订单率

metrics.name: discount_rate
metrics.description: 优惠金额除以支付订单原价金额；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when gross_cents = 0 then null else discount_cents / gross_cents end

metrics.label: 优惠率

metrics.name: items_per_order
metrics.description: 有效订单商品件数除以有效订单数；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when valid_order_count = 0 then null else valid_order_items / valid_order_count end

metrics.label: 单均商品件数

metrics.name: new_member_count
metrics.description: 按注册日期统计新注册 CRM 账户数；可按归属门店和会员等级分组，不等于自然人数。
metrics.label: 注册会员数

metrics.name: first_buyer_count
metrics.description: 在测试覆盖期内首次有效订单落入查询窗口的不同 CRM 账户数；不代表终身首购。先用全覆盖历史确定首次，再按窗口筛选。
metrics.label: 观测期首购会员数

metrics.name: first_order_sales_cents
metrics.description: 每个账户在测试覆盖期内第一笔有效订单的净销售额，按该单日期归属；相同日期按订单号排序；单位分。
metrics.label: 观测期首单净销售额

metrics.name: first_order_count
metrics.description: 在全测试覆盖期内先为每个账户按日期、订单号排序，其第一笔有效订单落入窗口的单数。
metrics.label: 观测期首单数

metrics.name: repeat_order_count
metrics.description: 账户全测试覆盖期内第二笔及以后的有效订单，按订单日期落入窗口计数。不是月内复购人数。
metrics.label: 观测期后续购买订单数

metrics.name: monthly_buyer_count
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径；不能跨月直接加总当人数。
metrics.label: 月内购买会员数

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.description: 同一自然月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数，仅整月、全门店口径。
metrics.label: 月内复购会员数

metrics.name: monthly_repeat_rate
metrics.description: 同一自然月的月内复购会员数除以月内购买会员数；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null；跨多月查询必须按月展示。

type_params.expr: case when monthly_buyer_count = 0 then null else monthly_repeat_buyer_count / monthly_buyer_count end

metrics.label: 月内复购率

metrics.name: monthly_paid_buyer_count
metrics.description: 自然月内有至少一笔有效订单、且月末符合付费资格的不同账户数；按账户去重，多卡不重复计人。
metrics.label: 月末付费会员购买人数

metrics.name: monthly_paid_order_count
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的全部有效订单数，按账户资格筛选，不按卡重复。
metrics.label: 月末付费会员有效订单数

metrics.name: monthly_paid_sales_cents
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格的账户在该自然月的有效订单净销售额合计，单位分。
metrics.label: 月末付费会员净销售额

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
metrics.description: 月末符合付费资格，且同一自然月至少有两笔有效订单的不同账户数。
metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购人数

metrics.name: monthly_paid_repeat_rate
metrics.description: 月末付费会员复购人数除以月末付费会员购买人数；分母为零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when monthly_paid_buyer_count = 0 then null else monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count / monthly_paid_buyer_count end

metrics.label: 月末付费会员复购率

metrics.name: monthly_paid_avg_order_value
metrics.description: 月末付费会员净销售额除以月末付费会员有效订单数；单位分／单，分母零时未定义，显式置 null。

type_params.expr: case when monthly_paid_order_count = 0 then null else monthly_paid_sales_cents / monthly_paid_order_count end

metrics.label: 月末付费会员订单均额
